name: MemoryLake
description: Cross-device long-term memory: recall and remember facts, get stored files back, manage workspaces.
description_zh: 跨设备长期记忆：召回和记住事实、找回存进 MemoryLake 的文件，管理工作区、项目和团队权限。
description_en: Cross-device long-term memory: recall and remember facts, get stored files back, manage workspaces.
examples_zh: 把 WorkBuddy 已有的记忆导入 MemoryLake

在 MemoryLake 里查一下我之前说过的项目截止日期
把我之前存进 MemoryLake 的季度报告下载下来
看看这个 MemoryLake 项目谁有读写权限
